meta.title: Ragyo — UTAU / OpenUTAU Voice Library
meta.description: Ragyo is a VCV UTAU / OpenUTAU voice library covering C2–B4 across three pitches plus Soft & Power tones. Samples, terms of use and downloads.

hero.tagline: Ink-blue, a vision's voice in one stroke.

about.title: The Library
about.lead: Ragyo is a VCV voice library for UTAU. Each of the three pitches is recorded in normal, Soft and Power tones, covering C2 through B4.
about.subbanksLead: These correspond to the subbanks defined in character.yaml. Each pitch is offered in normal, Soft and Power tones so you can pick per phrase.
about.enginesNote: OpenUTAU reads the subbanks declared in character.yaml directly, so tones can be switched through the CLR parameter.
about.sourceNote: Details on this page are compiled from the release package.

character.title: Character
character.lead: Ragyo — a wolf with ink-blue fur and red eyes, wearing a black headset and a microphone boom.
designNotes: Beneath the left side of both eyes there is fur shaped like (＞UWU＜), and a medium-length small braid sits at the back of the head. This is a key design point.
Both outfits included in the release are official costumes for Ragyo. Feel free to use them in your videos.
Ragyo's fur colour is “ink-like blue”. You may adjust the tone based on this impression.
In derivative works you are free to change Ragyo's outfit as you like.

download.title: Download
download.lead: Ragyo's voicebank and illustrations are distributed through the cloud storage services below.
download.voicebankNote: The voicebank package already includes the illustration files, so there is no need to download them separately.
download.overseasHint: {platform} primarily serves mainland China. Outside mainland China, please use Google Drive.
download.gdriveHint: Google Drive can be unreliable to access from mainland China; users in mainland China should prefer Quark Drive or Baidu Netdisk.
download.pendingBody: The download links are being prepared. Please check back once the release is public.
download.feedback: If a link does not open, please contact {author}.
installSteps: Use Tools → Install Singer to install the voicebank. rar, zip and uar archives are supported, and you can also drag an archive into the OpenUTAU window.
The installer previews the wav filenames and oto.ini inside the archive. If the text is garbled, choose the correct text encoding in the top-right corner.

Note: on non-Japanese systems, do not extract the archive manually — always install it via Install Singer. Once installed, "Ragyo" appears in the singer list with all three pitches and the Soft / Power tones ready to use.
installStepsUtau: Place the extracted folder into UTAU's voice directory.
Keep the folder name in single-byte alphanumeric characters; do not rename it.
